tie_break: higher score first; exact ties smaller number first
zscore: population mean and SD across all 10000 candidates

models.v2R: mean of z(expanding positional log probabilities), z(expanding adjacent-pair log probabilities), z(EW positional log probabilities half-life 30 draws)
models.v3: 0.45*z(rolling positional 30/60/120 with weights .5/.3/.2) + 0.25*z(rolling adjacent-pair 60/120 with weights .6/.4) + 0.15*z(rolling adjacent-triple 120) + 0.15*z(EW positional half-life 30)
models.v4A: log product of expanding per-position Laplace-smoothed probabilities

limitations: Not all 148 historical results independently cross-checked. GitHub commit timestamps provide external publication evidence; SHA256 by itself is not a timestamp.
